question: HA#586 OQ-1: when the host's base-branch merge (sync_with_base_branch) is unavailable, is the protected-path set readable from the checkout, or only from the host's refusal text?

options.label: Only the refusal text ⭐ (Recommended)
options.consequence: The host's protected set is not in the checkout, so the check stays a judgement the report records, quoting the refusal; murasaki and en name that route. Recorded as an HR row.

options.label: Readable from the checkout
options.consequence: The set can be read locally, so the check becomes a verb with an exit code; the nen half is filed and #586 waits for it.
